selected_script.angle: Preventing wet mop odors and floor stains by elevating cleaning tools onto a tile-mounted organizer
selected_script.hook: Leaving wet mops directly on the floor is the fastest way to ruin your tiles and get that awful damp smell.

video_001_part_01.scene_description: 0-3s: Close-up of a wet mop leaning in a bathroom corner, sliding down and leaving a dirty water stain on the floor. 3-6s: Hand pushes the mop handle into the white silicone roller clip of the light-gray wall-mounted holder on a clean tiled wall. 6-10s: Fast-cut showing a damp squeegee hanging from one of the J-hooks underneath.

video_001_part_02.scene_description: 0-4s: Fast-cut scene showing multiple tools (broom, mop, duster) neatly organized side-by-side in the five clip positions. 4-8s: Handheld pan showing the clean, empty floor space below the organizer. 8-10s: Clean floor view with overlay text: 'A simple upgrade for everyday use.'

final_moyin_jobs.promptText: Create a 10-second vertical TikTok-style ad video. Realistic handheld phone-shot style. Timeline: 0-3s: Show a real-life bad cleaning habit with a close-up of a wet mop leaning in a bathroom corner, sliding down and leaving a dirty water streak on the floor. 3-6s: A hand easily pushes the mop handle into the white silicone roller clip of the light-gray wall-mounted holder (5 white roller clips, 5 gray J-hooks) on a tile wall. 6-10s: Fast-cut scene 1 showing a damp squeegee hanging from one of the J-hooks beneath the organizer. Do not start with a perfect product shot. Do not end with a CTA. Keep the pacing fast, clear, and product-focused. Maintain product identity: light gray horizontal plastic bar with rounded end caps.
